tweets.text:
Made a custom fully open-source based KiCAD+OpenEMS physical simulation harness so that I can check the signal integrity of my PCB design before shipping it off to the fabs.

It's already working coz it flagged my board for signal integrity issues  😂 https://t.co/wLB8uybNTw
Twisted flex is generated on the fly in the designated FFC connectors and the whole 3d scene is "rasterized" into 3D FEA cells that OpenEMS accepts for simulation.
I then captured an oscilloscope reading of the source signal, dumped it to my computer and have the agent convert it to a OpenEMS phasor to replay it in the sim.
Currently this is a hodge podge of python scripts but perhaps it'd be helpful to combine it into one seamless open source app, when i get some more free time of course ;)

The final view is the KiCAD 3D model, the generated Flex cable mesh and OpenEMS's simulation output combined into one view. It generates a standalone html file that you can poke around and adjust animation parameters to.
